home.subtitle: Here is what needs you and where your work stands.
home.welcomeBody: Join an open challenge or share an idea.
home.ideasToTriage: New ideas waiting for a first check
home.noIdeas: You haven't shared an idea yet.
home.recognitionHint: Points are given for quality steps such as shortlisting and verified impact, not for the number of ideas.

challenges.listSubtitle: Problems posted by the company. Join alone or as a team.
challenges.eligibleForMeHint: Show only challenges I can join
challenges.emptyOpen: No open challenges right now. You can still share an idea.
challenges.modeBoth: Individual or team of up to {{max}}
challenges.registrationClosedOn: Registration for this challenge closed on {{date}}
challenges.howJudgedHint: Criteria and weights are shown openly so you can write what matters.
challenges.blindReviewNote: Blind review: judges don't see names or teams at the methodology stage.

prototypePolicy.NONE: No prototype is needed for this challenge.
prototypePolicy.OPTIONAL: A prototype is optional. It is scored only if you upload one.
prototypePolicy.REQUIRED_ALL: Every shortlisted entry must submit a prototype.
prototypePolicy.PANEL_DECIDES: After shortlisting, the judges decide which entries must submit a prototype.

challenges.noResources: No resources have been added yet.
challenges.noQuestions: No questions yet. Ask the first one.
challenges.waitingForAnswer: Waiting for an answer from the innovation office.
challenges.questionTooShort: Write your question in a full sentence.
challenges.askAnonymously: Hide my name from other employees
challenges.askAnonymouslyHint: The program owner can still see who asked.
challenges.inviteTeamBody: You are the team leader. Create a join link and share it; you approve each request.
challenges.alreadyRegistered: You're already registered for this challenge.
challenges.errMode: Choose how you will take part.
challenges.errTitle: Give your entry a working title.
challenges.errDeclaration: Accept the rules and the originality declaration.
challenges.asTeamHint: You will be the team leader. You can invite members with a join link ({{min}}–{{max}} people).
challenges.workingTitleHelp: A short name for your solution. You can refine it in your methodology.
challenges.shortSummaryHelp: One or two sentences. Shown publicly only if you win.
challenges.declaration: This is my or my team's original idea, I have not included secret client or third-party data, and I accept the challenge rules.

teams.lockedBanner: Team is locked. Member changes are closed.
teams.readOnly: Read only. You are not a member of this team.
teams.sharesBody: Shares must total 100%. Prizes are split by these shares; every member is notified of a change.
teams.sharesError: Credit shares must total 100%. They total {{total}}%.
teams.leaderBody: They will manage members and join links. You stay in the team as a member.
teams.removeBody: They lose access to the team's work immediately. Credit shares are split equally again.
teams.joinLinkHint: Anyone with the link can ask to join. You approve or decline each request.
teams.fullBanner: Team is full ({{current}} of {{max}}). Links are paused.
teams.noActiveLink: No active link. Create one to invite members.
teams.maskedHint: For safety the full link is shown only once. To share again, create a new link.
teams.createLinkBody: Set when the link stops working and how many people can use it.
teams.linkReadyBody: Copy it now. The full link is shown only once.
teams.linkCopied: Link copied. Anyone with this link can ask to join your team.
teams.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
teams.revokeBody: People who have it can no longer send join requests. Existing pending requests stay.
teams.noRequestsHint: Share your join link to invite people.
teams.declineBody: They get a polite notice. You can add a short reason.
teams.leaveHint: You can leave the team until registration closes.
teams.leaveBody: You lose access to the team's work immediately.
teams.leaderCannotLeave: To leave the team, first make another member the leader.
teams.messageHelp: Tell them your skills and why you want to join.
teams.messageRequired: Write a short message to the team leader.
teams.cancelBody: The team leader will no longer see it.
teams.previousDeclined: Your earlier request was declined. You can send a new one.
teams.linkInvalid: This join link no longer works. Ask the team leader for a new one.
